scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Welcome to Luoyang,
a city with a long
and colorful history.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
欢迎来到洛阳，
这是一座历史悠久、
色彩斑斓的城市。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Recently we've developed
an ocean lane to accomodate
positive exchange with
foreign nations.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
最近我们开辟了一条海上航线，
以促进与外国
积极的交流。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Luoyang is well-known for various specialties in addition to its rich history. Here you can find many things unique to our land.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
除了丰富的历史，洛阳还以各种特产闻名。在这里，您可以找到许多我们土地独有的物品。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Please take your time
and we invite you to enjoy
your trip here in Luoyang.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
请慢慢游览，
祝您在洛阳
旅途愉快。

scripts.text: Ask Building Locations.
scripts.translation: 询问建筑位置。

scripts.text: Remove all marks from mini-map.
scripts.translation: 清除小地图上的所有标记。

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Where would you like to go?
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
您想去哪里？

scripts.text: Dragon Castle
scripts.translation: 龙宫

scripts.text: Doctor's Office
scripts.translation: 医生诊所

scripts.text: City Hall
scripts.translation: 市政厅

scripts.text: Weapon Shop
scripts.translation: 武器店

scripts.text: Tool Shop
scripts.translation: 工具店

scripts.text: Tavern
scripts.translation: 酒馆

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
The Dragon Castle is located at ^FF3355+^000000. It is where all the nobles reside, including our lord.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
龙宫位于 ^FF3355+^000000。那里是所有贵族居住的地方，包括我们的领主。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Since you're an outsider, I guess it would be appropriate for you to visit our lord first.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
既然您是外乡人，我想您应该先拜访我们的领主。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
We have a very skillful doctor.
You can find her office at ^CE6300+^000000.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
我们有一位非常技艺高超的医生。
您可以在 ^CE6300+^000000 找到她的诊所。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
It is said that there
is no disease she cannot cure. Well, I can't guarantee if that's true or not.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
据说没有她治不好的病。嗯，不过我不能保证这是真的。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
We have a City Hall where the federal government operates.
It is located at ^A5BAAD+^000000.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
我们有一座市政厅，联邦政府在那里办公。
它位于 ^A5BAAD+^000000。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
If you have any problems,
you should talk with the
employees in City Hall.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
如果您有任何问题，
应该去市政厅
找那里的员工谈谈。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
The Weapon Shop is located at ^55FF33+^000000.

[Soldier]
You will see
marvelous weapons forged
by the well-experienced
blacksmiths of Luoyang.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
在那里，您会看到
由洛阳经验丰富的
铁匠打造的
精美武器。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
The Tool Shop is located at ^3355FF+^000000.

[Soldier]
Knowing your enemy
is half the battle!
It's also safer to prepare yourself than to be sorry later. Why don't you go check their supplies?
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
知己知彼，百战不殆！
提前做好准备总比事后后悔要好。您不妨去看看他们的补给品？

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
When you get tired during your trip, I suggest that you visit the Tavern. It's located at ^00FF00+^000000.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
当您在旅途中感到疲惫时，我建议您可以去酒馆休息一下。它位于 ^00FF00+^000000。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
The Tavern is a good place
to meet other tourists, as well as to hear of any news that may be helpful to know.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
酒馆是结识其他游客的好地方，
也能听到一些对您有用的消息。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
If you wish to remove all marks
on your mini-map, please choose 'Remove all marks from mini-map.' from the menu.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
如果您想清除小地图上的所有标记，
请在菜单中选择“清除小地图上的所有标记”。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
There, I've erased all the marks on your mini-map. Feel free to ask me about building locations whenever you need to.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
好了，我已经清除了您小地图上的所有标记。
如果您需要了解任何建筑的位置，随时可以问我。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
I guess it's fun
sometimes to go exploring
on your own. Take care.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
我想，有时候独自探索也是挺有趣的。
保重。

scripts.text:
[Representative]
Welcome to Luoyang,
an ancient land with
a history full of tales
of bravery.
scripts.translation:
[代表]
欢迎来到洛阳，
这是一片古老土地，
历史中充满了英勇的故事。

scripts.text:
[Representative]
We now provide an ocean lane to accomodate foreign travelers and intercultural exchange from which all can benefit.
scripts.translation:
[代表]
我们现在提供海上航线，
以方便外国旅行者的往来和文化交流，
让所有人都能从中受益。

scripts.text:
[Representative]
Luoyang is famous for
its elaborate history, as well as specialties that are unique to this nation. Please take your time and enjoy your stay.
scripts.translation:
[代表]
洛阳以其悠久的历史而闻名，
同时也拥有该国独有的特产。
请慢慢游览，祝您在此度过愉快的时光。

scripts.text: Ask Building Locations.
scripts.translation: 询问建筑位置。

scripts.text: Remove all marks from mini-map.
scripts.translation: 清除小地图上的所有标记。

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Representative]
I understand that you want to explore Luoyang and see the
sights for yourself. Alright then, take care!
scripts.translation:
[代表]
我理解您想去洛阳探索，亲眼看看那里的风景。
那么，祝您旅途愉快！
